status: FROZEN once frozen_manifest_v5.json is committed. Implementation approved 2026-11-25; MARKET EVALUATION NOT YET APPROVED.
extends: protocol.json (v2: data, periods, costs, T1-T10, holdout), protocol_v4_stats.json (statistical rules)
family: A - trend-filtered, volatility-scaled crypto basket vs cash

universe.bias: survivor-biased (listed and still trading in 2026); labelled in every report
universe.warmup: candles before the evaluation start are history only; SMA(200) needs 200 completed days

parameters.rationale: 50/100/200-day filters and a 40 % volatility target (about half the basket's historical volatility) are conventions / a risk budget, fixed before any market result; none was tuned

variants.V0: volatility scaling only, score fixed at 1 (descriptive trial)

decision_time: 00:00 UTC candle open, completed days only; orders fill at that candle's open

execution.costs: BASE 0.10 % fee + 0.05 % slippage per side; STRESS 0.20 % + 0.10 %

circuit_breaker.halt_behaviour: no new entries; pending entry orders cancelled; every position liquidated at the next candle open with fees, slippage and the volume participation cap (remainder continues each following candle, never expires); no automatic restart in the same evaluation run (terminal)
circuit_breaker.impact_reporting: reported separately from the ON run: halt time, equity and drawdown at halt, days flat afterwards, entries blocked, liquidation cost. A breaker-OFF counterfactual is NOT part of the evaluation; it needs a separate explicit owner approval and would be labelled diagnostic

registered: H1: net annualised Sharpe of A1 > 0
H2: A1 Sharpe exceeds the unscaled basket B1 (paired block bootstrap)
hypotheses.multiple_testing: Holm over 2; N trials = 40 + 3 (A1, A0, V0) = 43
hypotheses.volatility_targeting: V0 vs B1 is reported but never counted as alpha

trade_definition: T1 counts position episodes (entry to flat) per pair; partial rebalances are not trades
criteria: T1-T10 unchanged (protocol.json); T9 not evaluated (no parameter sweep); benchmark rule B1-B5 as in protocol v3
evaluation_period: 2021-01-01..2025-07-01 (research data); holdout 2025-07-01..2026-11-25 untouched, single use per finalist after separate written approval
known_consequence: a terminal halt may truncate an evaluation run exactly as it did for R1; the report must show time-to-halt and the part of the period traded
rejected_not_reused: R1 and all Phase 4 ablations including no_stop_cooldown
